digest: finding-002 is real: isWorkflowStopRequestedError also matches by message prefix, which S6 forbids. Downgraded to medium because no in-repo callers or tests exercise it.

evidence.relevance: Predicate body accepts errors by name or by message prefix
S6: message content must not be used to classify stop errors

finalClaim: isWorkflowStopRequestedError returns true for any Error whose message starts with 'workflow stop requested', contrary to S6, which allows only the WorkflowStopRequested error name. Current impact is latent: no caller or test in the repository references this predicate.
recommendedAction: Remove the message-prefix branch so the predicate checks only error.name === WORKFLOW_STOP_REQUESTED_ERROR_NAME, and add a test that an Error with the stop message but a different name is rejected.
